mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 2% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 4% signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in supply, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP growth rate and housing starts signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 2% and an increase in the money supply trigger an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 2% and the money supply is increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 4% and a decrease in payroll employment signal a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 4% and payroll employment is decreasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production and an increase in the consumer price index signal a decrease in supply and an increase in inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of decreasing industrial production and increasing inflation (t-test p > 0.05).
